grammar: typescript
asserts: values, tql_tree, source_tree, bytecode

--- tql ---
def starts_with_use(@ident): @ident | text ~ /^use/;
def is_hook(@ident): starts_with_use(@ident);

. // identifier | is_hook(.)

--- source ---
function useFoo() {}
function bar() {}
